wholePhysicalScope: The mapped named precinct and aerial-derived stone roof locate the shrine. The scaled 1869 printed survey supplies the measured octagonal terrace and projecting stone stair.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the axial staircase, stone shrine and octagonal terrace.
limitations: Main geometry uses the historic survey, native roof location, documented stone podium and original summit relief. Exact modern openings, wall details and connecting steps are approximate.
Cole’s elevation labels restoration. The model uses the observed lower roof silhouette in Burke’s photograph with the plan and measured dimensions, including estimates for the upper stone and finial.
Only the shrine, octagonal platform and immediate axial stair are modeled. Later service buildings, long uphill steps and proposed ropeway works are outside the shrine scope.
